task.text:
explain: Albumin binds different drugs and strongly affects the pharmacokinetics of these drugs.
> For example, sulfonamides can cause the release of unconjugated bilirubin from albumin by competitive binding. If given to infants, sulfonamides may lead to kernicterus.
